selgitus.pealkiri: How the seats in a district were allocated
selgitus.sissejuhatus: The district has {mandaate} seats and {hääli} valid votes.
selgitus.isikumandaat.puudub: No candidate reached the simple quota ({kvoot} votes).
selgitus.isikumandaat: Candidates who received at least the simple quota ({kvoot} votes) are elected, whatever the result of their list:
selgitus.ringkonnamandaat: A party gets one seat for each full simple quota of its votes, and one more if the remainder is at least 75% of the quota. The seats go to the party's candidates with the most votes who have at least 10% of the quota; personal mandates count towards the party's seats.
selgitus.allaKünnise: Lists below the 5% threshold get no district mandates: {erakonnad}.
selgitus.lisamandaat: The remainder was at least 75% of the simple quota, so one extra seat
selgitus.alla10: No seat because below 10% of the simple quota ({piir} votes): {kandidaadid}
selgitus.jagamata: The district allocated {jaotatud} seats. {jagamata} seats remained and go to the national allocation of compensation mandates.
kompensatsioon.künnis: District and compensation mandates go to lists that received at least 5% of the valid votes, that is {künnis} of {kehtivaid} votes:
kompensatsioon.arv: The districts allocated {ringkondades} seats, so {kompensatsioon} compensation mandates are allocated nationally.
kompensatsioon.dhondt: For each seat, every party gets a comparison figure: its votes divided by (n + 1)^0.9, where n is the number of seats it already has. The seat goes to the party with the highest figure, and to the candidate highest on its national list who has at least 5% of the simple quota in their district. The table shows the comparison figures of each step; the party that won the seat is highlighted.
kompensatsioon.viik.selgitus: The comparison figures were equal; the seat went to the party placed further back in the combined district list (§ 62(5)).
kompensatsioon.varureegel.selgitus: The list had no candidate with 5% of the quota left; the seat went to the candidate with the highest share of the quota (§ 62(7)).
kandidaadid.selgitus: Candidates ranked by the percentage of repeated simulations in which they were elected; votes and mandate are those of the example run. The frequency depends on the party result (including the poll error when it is on) and on the list position, because party votes are split among the candidates by the split chosen below. A candidate's personal popularity is not modelled.
kandidaadid.jaotus.selgitus.kalibreeritu: A candidate's expected share of the party votes falls in the order of the district list; in a list of ten, for example, the first candidate gets {esimene}% on average, or {esimeneEsiviisikus}% if in the top five of the party's national list. The random variation around the expected share and all parameters are fitted to the candidate votes of the 2023 election. In a test where each district in turn was left out of the fit, this split named on average {kalibreeritud} of the {kohti} candidates elected at the district level correctly, the simple split {lihtne}.
kandidaadid.jaotus.selgitus.lihtne: The first candidate gets half of the party votes on average, the next half of the rest, and so on. This split ignores the national list. It was the simulator's original split.
kandidaadid.selgitus.tegelikud: Candidates elected in the 2023 election, with their actual votes.
jalus.mudel: A simulation, not a forecast: the result depends on the poll data and on how party votes are assumed to split among candidates. The seat allocation itself follows the law and reproduces the official result from the actual 2023 votes.
näidiskordus: Example run with seed {seeme}: the poll support exactly, without error, and one random split of the votes among the candidates. Other runs can give a different result; the ranges and medians of the runs are shown above.
näidiskordus.tegelikud: Actual votes received by the candidates in the 2023 election.
kaart.selgitus.tegelikud: The colour shows the party with the most elected candidates in the district; the seat split is shown alongside. Click a district to see its calculation below.
parlament.alus.veaga: The hemicycle shows the average composition over {kordi} runs, poll error included.
parlament.alus.veata: The hemicycle shows the average composition over {kordi} runs, poll error not included.
parlament.mandaadiga.selgitus: Share of runs in which the party won at least one seat
parlament.jaotus.silt: Distribution of {erakond} seats across runs: {min} to {max}; lighter bars are outside the 90% range
mc.valmis.veaga: Each run first moves the party support by a poll error: the error is shared across the country, with smaller deviations by district. The size of the national error comes from a backtest of pollster accuracy in the 2011–2023 elections (each pollster's house effect and the error common to all pollsters); the district part comes from the 2023 election. The run then splits each party's votes among its candidates at random. The range shows how many seats the party won in 90% of the runs.
mc.valmis.veata: The poll error is not included: party votes are the same in every run, and the runs only split them among the candidates again at random. The party seat counts therefore vary little.
jalus.ajalugu: Poll history 2011–2023 (for the aggregate and pollster accuracy)
parlament.lause: The largest party would be {erakond}: {p05}⁠–⁠{p95} seats in 90% of runs, median {mediaan}; largest in {osakaal} of runs.
ringkonnad.selgitus: Average number of candidates elected from each district by party, compensation mandates included. Click a row to see the district's calculation below.
ringkonnad.selgitus.tegelikud: Candidates elected from each district by party, compensation mandates included. Click a row to see the district's calculation below.
koalitsioonid.selgitus: How often a coalition would win at least {enamus} seats. The bar shows the coalition's 90% range of seats and the tick its median; the blue dashed line is the majority boundary. Only seat counts are considered, not whether the parties would work together.
koalitsioonid.vali: Select parties to see the coalition's chance of a majority.
koalitsioonid.valitud: {koalitsioon}: {vahemik} seats in 90% of runs, median {mediaan}; majority in {tõenäosus} of runs.
piirikohad.selgitus: In the example run with seed {seeme} (the poll support exactly): how few votes would change the seat allocation. This is the tactical voting question: where a small number of votes would matter.
piirikohad.selgitus.tegelikud: With the actual 2023 votes: how few votes would change the seat allocation.
piirikohad.viimane: The last compensation mandate went to {võitja}; next in line was {järgmine}, which was {puudu} votes short nationally.
piirikohad.saadud: District seats won by the smallest margin
piirikohad.kuskohalt: An extra district seat usually only changes where the party's MPs come from, because it is subtracted from its compensation mandates; exceptions are marked.
piirikohad.meetod: The district seat threshold follows from the simple quota and the 0.75 remainder rule (Election Act § 62(3)). An extra district seat is subtracted from the party's compensation mandates if it has any; then only the origin of its MPs changes, not their number. A new seat also needs a candidate with at least 10% of the quota. The compensation threshold is the gap between the comparison figures in the last step, multiplied by the next party's divisor (§ 62(5)).
parlament.mediaan.selgitus: In half of the runs the party won this many seats or fewer
koalitsioonid.meetod: Listed are minimal coalitions: without any one member, the coalition would not have a majority in at least half of the runs. Up to {arv} coalitions with a majority probability of at least 1% are shown.
kandidaadid.jaotus.kuidas: How are votes split among candidates?
kandidaadid.loendus: {kindlad} candidates were elected in more than 95% of runs; {piiril} candidates were borderline, elected in 5–95% of runs.
sisend.ruudud.selgitus: The cells show the party's support in each district: the darker, the closer to the party's strongest district (each party has its own scale). Point at a column or focus a cell to see the district's name. Click a cell to change it, for example to test tactical voting. The "Others" row is the share of the valid votes left for other lists and independent candidates; red means that the parties' support in the district exceeds 100%.
seeme.uus.selgitus: New random seed: the repeated simulations and the example run are computed again.
sisend.muud.selgitus: The share of the valid votes that none of the parties above receives: other lists and independent candidates. The simulator gives them no seats. It follows from the party support: when a party grows, the others' share shrinks.
parlament.viga.näide: The error is typically ±{protsent}% of the party's own support: for {erakond} at {toetus}, support falls within {alla}–{üle}% in about two thirds of the runs.
sisend.kaart.vihje: Point at a column or at a district on the map to see where it is.
samm.allikas.näidis: Example run with seed {seeme}: the poll support exactly and one random split of the votes among the candidates.
samm.allikas.tegelikud: The actual votes of the 2023 election.
samm.algus.1: The 101 seats of the Riigikogu are allocated under § 62 of the Riigikogu Election Act in three stages: personal mandates, district mandates and compensation mandates. Before that, the lists that passed the 5% threshold are determined.
samm.algus.2: In a district, all of a party's seats come from one calculation: how many simple quotas its votes contain. They are shown one at a time here only to explain them. Compensation mandates are really allocated one after another, because each allocated seat changes the comparison figures for the next.
samm.algus.3: Move with the buttons, the arrow keys or the slider. The step size sets how far each step goes: a whole stage, one district or one seat.
samm.künnis: Only lists with at least 5% of the valid votes nationally receive district and compensation mandates: {künnis} votes of {kehtivaid}. The line on the bars marks 5%.
samm.künnis.isikumandaat: The threshold does not affect personal mandates: a candidate who reaches the simple quota in a district is elected even if the party is below 5% or the candidate is independent.
samm.kvoot: The district has {mandaate} seats and {hääli} valid votes. The simple quota is {hääli} / {mandaate} = {kvoot} votes.
samm.kvoot.selgitus: The bar shows the party's votes in simple quotas. Each full quota gives one seat; if the remainder passes the dashed line (0.75 of a quota), the party gets one more seat. Only parties above the 5% threshold are shown.
samm.isikumandaat: {nimi} ({erakond}) received {hääli} votes, at least the simple quota ({kvoot} votes). The candidate is elected regardless of how many votes the list received. The line on the bar marks the simple quota.
samm.isikumandaat.erakonnale: The seat counts among the district mandates of {erakond}: it is the party's first seat in this district.
samm.isikumandaat.eraldi: The candidate's list is below the 5% threshold, or the candidate is independent, so this seat is outside the parties' district mandates.
samm.ringkonnamandaat.kvoodid: {erakond} received {hääli} votes in the district, or {kvoote} simple quotas, which gives {mandaate} seats.
samm.ringkonnamandaat.täiskvoodist: Seat {koht} comes from full quota number {koht} (framed).
samm.ringkonnamandaat.jäägist: Seat {koht} comes from the remainder: {jääk} quotas is at least 0.75 (framed).
samm.ringkonnamandaat.kandidaat: The party's seats go to its candidates with the most votes who have at least 10% of the simple quota ({piir} votes). Seat {koht} goes to {nimi}, {hääli} votes.
samm.jagamata: No candidate with at least 10% of the simple quota ({piir} votes) is left for seat {koht}. The seat stays unfilled in the district and joins the compensation mandates.
samm.jagamata.kandidaat: Next in line would have been {nimi}, with {hääli} votes.
samm.kandidaadid.selgitus: The party's candidates in the district by votes; the black line is 10% of the simple quota ({piir} votes). Light bars fall below it.
samm.ringkond.jagamata: The district allocated {jaotatud} of {mandaate} seats. {jagamata} stays unfilled and joins the national allocation of compensation mandates.
samm.ringkonnad: The districts allocated {jaotatud} seats in total (personal and district mandates). {jagamata} seats are allocated as compensation mandates.
samm.komp.algus: The districts allocated {ringkondades} seats, so {komp} compensation mandates are allocated nationally among the parties above the 5% threshold.
samm.komp.meetod: For each seat, each party's comparison figure is its national votes divided by (n + 1)^0.9, where n is the number of seats the party already has (including district seats). The seat goes to the party with the largest comparison figure. Its n then grows by one, and the comparison figures are computed again for the next seat.
samm.komp.võrdlusarv: The comparison figure of {erakond} is the largest: {hääli} votes / ({juba} + 1)^0.9 = {hääli} / {jagaja} = {võrdlusarv}.
samm.komp.diagramm: The bars are this step's comparison figures; point at a bar to see the calculation.
samm.komp.kandidaat: The seat goes to the highest-placed candidate on the party's national list who is not yet elected and has at least 5% of the simple quota in their district: {nimi} (number {nr} on the list, district {ringkond}, {hääli} votes; 5% threshold {piir} votes).
samm.komp.vahelejäetud: Higher on the list, {kandidaadid} had less than 5% of their district's simple quota and were skipped.
samm.komp.varureegel: No free candidate had 5% of the simple quota, so the candidate with the largest share of the quota got the seat (Election Act § 62(7)); higher on the list were {kandidaadid}.
samm.lõpp: The table shows each party's district mandates (including personal mandates), compensation mandates and total seats.
